Jack Ma admitted he knew nothing about technology or management when he started Alibaba. Instead of trying to master everything, he focused on finding people smarter than him in areas like computers and accounting. His philosophy was simple: leaders don't need to know it all-they need to bring the right people together. Smart individuals often struggle to collaborate, but with the right vision and leadership, they can create powerful results. This approach turned Alibaba from a small startup into a global giant valued at over $200 billion. Jack Ma's lesson: success is less about personal expertise and more about building teams that share a vision and work as one.#entrepreneurs #entrepreneurship #onlinebusinesstips #money #ecom
